notes.title: Playtest Active Again!
notes.notes:
Apparently the game's playtest has not been granting access to new users for a while.
Someone let me know about this via e-mail, and I've just let in all ~140 people waiting for access.
The playtest is also set to "open", so any new requests should immediately be fulfilled.
Contact me by e-mail if you still encounter any issues.

notes.title: Bonus Story released!
notes.notes:
A Bonus Story for The Game For Skippers has been released. You need to own the base game.
To play it, you need to follow these steps:
1. Right-click The Game For Skippers in your library.
2. Properties > Local files > Browse
3. Open the new Bonus Story folder. (make sure the DLC has been installed, try to verify files if it does not show up)
4. Launch the SkippersBonus.exe.
5. Enjoy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590590/The_Game_For_Skippers__Bonus_Story/
